verdict.rationale: Jev returns AI judgments on user-supplied data. In the Playground you paste text as state and ask Noul, Choice or Score questions, and the API returns typed answers with probabilities and confidence (jev-supp-playground, jev-docs-21, jev-docs-20, jev-docs-7, jev-docs-8, jev-docs-9), and hands-on users report using it for fast decisions and classification (jev-comm-4, jev-comm-6). These are narrow, question-driven typed decisions rather than open-ended insights or suggestions, and the vendor lists generation as a known weak spot (jev-supp-jaggedness). Missing for 10: proactive or unprompted insights, free-form suggestions or recommendations, in-product analysis of connected data sources beyond pasted state.
